rationale: With only 21 minutes to close and price already up ~10% on the day, sitting at 87% of its range near the session high, the risk/reward for a new directional entry is poor — a long risks a late-day fade into liquidation while a short faces strong upward momentum with SPY up ~5% and VIX futures down sharply.
